narrative: I'm stepping into a newly created VP of Data Platform role at a Series C fintech company. There is no existing data team, no analytics infrastructure, and no established roadmap to inherit — I'm building the function from scratch, hiring the first five engineers, and defining what 'good' looks like from zero. My CEO has asked me to stand up a greenfield data platform within two quarters, and there is no legacy system to migrate away from because nothing exists yet.

diagnosis.rationale: The narrative describes building a function from scratch with no existing team, infrastructure, or roadmap to inherit — phrases like 'no existing data team, no analytics infrastructure' and 'building the function from scratch' are hallmark Startup-situation signals, not the recognition-and-repair of something that already exists.
evidence: no existing data team, no analytics infrastructure
building the function from scratch, hiring the first five engineers
